visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A blonde woman (Niniru) is seated in the back of a car, speaking directly to the camera with high energy. She wears a white button-down shirt under a grey knit vest and a black headband. Raindrops are visible on the car window behind her. (2) The scene shifts to the interior of a Logitech G retail store. The woman is standing on a small elevated stage holding a microphone. Two young men wearing white and yellow esports jerseys (CFO team) stand beside her. A large crowd of fans is visible in the foreground and background, many holding up smartphones. (3) On the stage, the woman interacts with the players. The store background features bright blue and green neon lighting, rows of gaming peripherals, and large digital screens. The woman points to products and promotional cards. (4) Two executives, a woman in a red shirt and a man in a navy polo, join the stage. They shake hands with the players and present them with branded apparel. The woman (Niniru) continues to host the segment. (5) Niniru is seen interacting with fans off-stage, taking selfies and smiling. The environment is crowded and lively. (6) The video concludes with Niniru back on camera, waving and making a peace sign towards the viewer in front of a store display.
